utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'll dig it out and bring it by on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Saturday works. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, Vik told me about it. Saturday at the community center. I'm planning to bring some tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hmm, Vik did mention something. Okay, I'll bring some spare parts then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, spare parts will be really useful! See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive on Saturday? I'm helping out there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, actually Sam, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center. I'll be bringing some tools and snacks. Can you make it on Sunday instead?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for letting me know! Sunday works for me too. I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll bring my old toaster and a set of screwdrivers. I like to have a clear list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good idea, Eli. Do we need to sort items by type when we bring them in?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I think that would be wise. A place for everything and everything in its place, I always say.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great to hear you're on track, Opal! I'll see you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Looking forward to it, Mara. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I'll make sure we have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I thought it was at the school. Well, wherever it is, I'm still too busy to help. Thanks for the heads up though.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Wait, what's happening again? I think I left my toaster somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Your toaster? Maybe that's what they're fixing—old appliances. I'd check the school or community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, did I miss something about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4, fixing electronics and furniture. I thought it was park benches too, but Vik set me straight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, got it—so it's electronics and furniture. Thanks for catching me up, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yes, the repair drive! It's this Saturday at the community center from 10am to 4pm. We're fixing old electronics and furniture together!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you planning to bring to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just worried we won't have enough tools to fix everything. Do you think you could bring any spare wrenches?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I've got a couple of spare wrenches I can bring. I'll also ask around if anyone else can lend tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief, thanks Jules. Every little bit helps—I'll round up my toolbox too just in case.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Tess! Have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, I'm so excited! I'm bringing my wrench set to help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great! I'm so glad you're joining—I've been meaning to fix my old toaster, so this is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be great, Rosa. Thanks for offering to help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I appreciate that, Rey! I'll definitely take you up on that offer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, let's head over to Oren's garage and grab that binder.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Gus, thanks for offering. I've actually got a few things in my garage I need to dig out first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah. Let me know if you come up short on anything—I'll be happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do, Gus. I appreciate that—I'll give you a shout if I can't find something.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hello Dane! I'm so glad you're interested in the repair drive. How can I help you get involved?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'd like to join in. What should I bring or do to help out?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great question! The drive is now Sunday at the community center. We're meeting tomorrow at 6 PM to assign tasks, but for now, just bring your enthusiasm—and if you have any basic tools, that would be helpful too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, maybe they moved it. Either way, I'm too busy to join.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, no worries. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do, thanks Leo.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, are you set for the repair drive? I've got a shed full of tools if you need to borrow any.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's so kind of you, Gus! I might take you up on that—I've got an old clock that's been ticking wrong for months.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: An old clock? I've got a set of small screwdrivers and some lubricant that might do the trick. Want me to bring those along on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I just found out from Vik that the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10am to 4pm, fixing old electronics and furniture.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to know the times are set. I just hope they stick to the schedule—10 to 4 sounds reasonable.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, hopefully it runs smoothly. I'm planning to bring in an old lamp that needs rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Huh, so there really is one. But who's actually in charge?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm helping to organize it, along with a few other parents. Need any more details?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You? Huh. Okay, so what time does it start on Saturday? And do you need specific supplies?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, I trust what Vik said. We should plan for it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But are we sure we have enough tools? I'd hate to start and run into problems.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check my shed—I've got a few hammers and screwdrivers we can use.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'll bring it by. It's not much, but maybe they can fix it up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Uli! Every little bit helps. I'm sure they'll appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I hope they can do something with it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, it's happening! I'm helping coordinate with Mara. Want to join us, Kira?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm already signed up and just finished my part on the south end.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great job, Opal! Hey, if you're free, could you help spread the word to others? We need more hands for the benches.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Jules, are you thinking of going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Mina! It's at the community center from 10 to 4. You should come—it's a lot of fun fixing things together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you planning to bring to fix, Jules?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, I'm bringing my wrench set. What about you, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll be there too, helping organize everything. It's going to be great to have your wrench set on hand!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be great, Rosa. Let's go check the garage together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, are we all heading to the garage? I should grab my list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, let's all go together—Rosa and I were just about to head over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Oren, I understand it's a community event where we collect and fix old appliances and furniture. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, that's it! Fixing up old things together. I have a toaster somewhere I keep meaning to bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's great, Oren! I'll look forward to seeing that toaster—maybe we can get it working again.
